description: This file defines the 'Container' interface for OFBiz, outlining lifecycle methods (init, start, stop) and a method to get the container's name. It includes licensing info and package/import statements.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: An interface representing an OFBiz container with lifecycle methods for initialization, starting, stopping, and retrieving the container's name.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with command-line arguments, a unique name, and a configuration file (always null).

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container process, must not block, returns true if successful.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the container process, must not block.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container instance.
